gallery.description: John Trumbull's painting, Declaration of Independence, depicting the five-man drafting committee of the Declaration of Independence presenting their work to the Congress. The painting can be found on the back of the U.S. $2 bill. The original hangs in the US Capitol rotunda. It does not represent a real ceremony; the characters portrayed were never in the same room at the same time.

gallery.description:
"Grand centennial celebration of the Boston Tea Party, at Tremont Temple. Tuesday evening, Dec. 16th [1873], at 7:30 p.m." 
"... Historical scene paintings made by Low & Curtis."
"... Proceeds in aid of the building fund of the Boston Young Women's Christian Association."

Participants included the Boston Light Infantry and the Beethoven Quintette Club.
